title: TauIndianBankBench：面向工具使用对话智能体的流程感知、行动导向评估基准
summary: 该研究提出 TauIndianBankBench，包含 1000 个印度零售银行任务，用于评估语言模型智能体是否按银行规定流程执行操作。仅检查最终记录时，6.5%-12.0% 的会话被误判为成功，而实际存在跳过必要步骤或做出未请求变更的问题；同时评估流程与结果能更准确反映模型表现。
summary_en: TauIndianBankBench is a 1,000-task benchmark for Indian retail banking that evaluates whether LLM agents follow required procedures, not just final records. Checking only outcomes misjudges 6.5-12.0% of sessions as successful despite skipped steps or unrequested changes; scoring both procedure and outcome gives a more accurate measure of model performance.
